summary: Eldorado Gold filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated September 21, 2026 that provides Q3 2026 conference call details and an updated reporting date. The company will release third quarter 2026 financial and operational results after market close on October 28, 2026, and host a conference call on October 29, 2026 at 9:00 AM ET (6:00 AM PT). The reporting date differs slightly from the schedule published January 20, 2026. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms are stated; this is a routine scheduling announcement, not a special situation.
